# Proverbs 1 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

## 1:3 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | To-receive discipline-of prudence, righteousness and-justice and-uprightness, |
| LOGOS | To receive instruction in wise dealing, in righteousness, justice, and equity, |
| PNEUMA | So you can learn to live with good sense — doing what is right, just, and fair, |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
